synthesizedFacts.fact: Collagen is a ubiquitous biomaterial in vertebrate animals and is the main structural protein in the extracellular matrix of various tissues.
There are 28 subtypes of collagen, with types I, II, and III making up 80–90% of the collagen in the human body.
High-throughput and low-cost methods for collagen subtype quantification do not yet exist.
The Soluble Collagen Assay Kit detects newly synthesized (acid-soluble) collagen levels in various biological samples and cultured cell medium.
